title: Patch-Sandbox-Prozessbudget vom bestehenden Hostbestand entkoppeln
goal: Härte den RepoGround Patch-Evaluation-Sidecar so, dass sein begrenztes Prozessbudget weiterhin fail-closed wirkt, aber nicht als absoluter RLIMIT_NPROC-Wert unterhalb des bereits bestehenden Prozessbestands des realen Operator-Nutzers gesetzt wird. Ein belasteter Host mit mehr als 256 bestehenden Nutzerprozessen darf die isolierte Bubblewrap-Ausführung nicht allein deshalb mit EAGAIN blockieren.

acceptance.assertion: A revisions-bound test or proof reproduces the current failure mode where the real user's existing process count is greater than the absolute `_MAX_COMMAND_PROCESSES` limit and Bubblewrap exits before the payload with `Resource temporarily unavailable`.
The sandbox retains an explicit bounded incremental process budget for the evaluated payload without setting an absolute real-UID RLIMIT_NPROC below the already existing host process count.

Bubblewrap PID, IPC, UTS and network isolation, filesystem restrictions, command timeout, output bounds and the remaining prlimit controls stay fail-closed; the fix does not broaden payload capabilities or silently disable process limiting.

Regression coverage models a host process baseline above the payload budget and proves that a bounded sandbox command can start while a process-fork storm is still rejected within the intended incremental budget.
Targeted Sidecar tests, the full RepoGround test suite, CodeQL and CI are green, and a real loaded operator-host canary succeeds with before/after process-count and limit evidence.

A proof records the selected Linux RLIMIT/user-namespace semantics, residual risks and why the change fixes host coupling without claiming a global per-command kernel quota that Linux does not provide.

observed_failure.error: bwrap: Creating new namespace failed: Resource temporarily unavailable
observed_failure.fresh_runner_counterevidence: GitHub pytest-full on RepoGround PR #1117 passed after installing the same sandbox runtime, isolating the failure to the loaded host contract rather than T019.

reviewed_plan.basis: The failure was reproduced twice on the loaded host, a direct Bubblewrap probe without the absolute nproc limit succeeded, the real-user process count exceeded the configured limit, and the same RepoGround head passed the full sandbox suite on a fresh GitHub runner. The task is separated from T019 and does not prescribe an unverified kernel-level solution.
